messages.subject: Project Cedar — engagement and next steps
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Robert,

Thank you for instructing us on the Caldera Mobility manufacturing and supply arrangement. I attach our engagement letter for Project Cedar setting out scope, team and fees. Sarah Whitfield will supervise and I will be your day-to-day contact, with Elena Marchetti supporting.

As a first step we will get the mutual NDA in place so the technical and commercial teams can exchange the CM-7 build data. Could you let me know who on your side should be named as the signatory and the points of contact for the data exchange?

We look forward to working with you on this.

Kind regards,
James

James Osei | Senior Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0521
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

James,

Thanks — engagement letter received and we're happy with the terms. I'll sign and return today.

I'll be the signatory for Halstead. Grace Underwood (cc'd, our Group FD) and Helen Forsythe (Operations) are the commercial contacts; Priya Saxena leads on quality. Please go ahead with the NDA — Caldera are keen to move quickly.
